title: Director of Legal and Compliance
posting_excerpt:
eneurial-minded lawyer to join a company at a formative stage, working directly with the CEO to establish the frameworks, policies, and agreements that will govern how Synquery operates as it scales. You will wear multiple hats — advisor, negotiator, program-builder, and strategic partner to leadership — in an environment where your decisions will have immediate impact.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead compliance strategy: Design, implement, and manage comprehensive compliance programs covering Synquery's internal personnel as well as the network of experts who engage with the platform.

• Build the compliance infrastructure: Establish policies, training, and monitoring processes to ensure adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., expert network compliance norms, confidentiality and information barriers, data privacy).

• Negotiate key agreements: Draft, review, and negotiate client agreements, partner agreements, expert agreements, vendor contracts, and other core business documents.

• Manage legal risk: Identify, assess, and mitigate legal and regulatory risks across the business, including those specific to AI-enabled products and services.

• Advise leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and broader leadership team on legal, regulatory, and compliance matters affecting business strategy and operations.

• Shape company policy: Help define internal governance practices, employment policies, and operational procedures as the company scales.

• Manage outside counsel: Engage and coordinate with external law firms on specialized matters as needed, while keeping day-to-day legal work in-house.

• Support corporate matters: Assist with corporate governance, entity management, and other general corporate legal needs as they arise.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• J.D.: from an accredited law school; active bar membership in good standing.

• 3+ years: of experience as a corporate lawyer or in-house counsel, ideally with exposure to contract negotiation and compliance programs.

• Strong drafting and negotiation skills across commercial agreements (client, partner, and vendor contracts).

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to regulated information services, data privacy, or expert networks (preferred, not required).

• A builder's mindset — comfortable creating structure and process.

• Sound judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with business pragmatism in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent communication skills and the confidence to advise senior leadership directly.

• Self-starter energy: this role has significant autonomy and will require someone who is comfortable defining their own scope as the company's needs evolve.




WHY JOIN SYNQUERY

• Direct line to the CEO and a real seat at the table in shaping company strategy.

• The chance to build a legal and compliance function.

• Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and growth potential at an early-stage company positioned in a large and expanding market.

• A collaborative, fast-paced culture where impact is immediate and visible.



Note: This role can be flexible between part-time and full-time, structured around the scope of responsibilities the candidate takes on.



Synquery is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Counsel, Legal Operations & Compliance
location: Edina, MN; Edina, Minnesota, United States
posting_excerpt:
vironments. The kind of people who hold themselves to high standards, think creatively, and find satisfaction in solving hard problems.

When you join our team, you’ll work alongside some of the most experienced leaders in the industry — professionals who share their knowledge freely and lead by example. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to take ownership of meaningful work that shapes the future of one of the fastest-growing industries in America.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Minnesota-barred attorney to be the senior hands-on lawyer inside our legal operations and compliance function. If you love the craft of legal work — getting it exactly right, at volume, on time — this seat delivers more real ownership and more interesting variety than most attorneys see in a decade: cannabis regulatory work, commercial leases, entity and license management, compliance infrastructure, and daily collaboration with an executive team that moves fast.

You'll join a small, established legal team, working alongside two paralegals whose work you'll help mentor and elevate, with meaningful room to grow as the function scales.

What You'll Do

- Own the master renewal calendar: entity renewals, state and local license renewals, and applications — inventoried, deadlined, executed, never late.

- Review and abstract commercial leases, maintain the lease database, and support subleasing and landlord communications.

- Build and maintain audit-ready compliance records; support regulatory filings, disclosures, and exam response.

- Draft, review, and manage contracts, corporate documents, and entity records; help elevate paralegal work with a mentoring mindset.

- Support the insurance program: certificate tracking, renewals, COI requirements.

- Practice at the frontier: we use AI legal tools daily for drafting, review, and research — with privilege rigorously protected — and we'll invest in keeping you at the cutting edge.

Who Thrives Here

Detail-obsessed attorneys who take real pride in execution and want their work to matter visibly. We're an in-person team by design — on-site in Edina, five days a week — because that's how mentorship and momentum actually happen. Comfort working in a bipartisan, politically diverse environment is part of the culture: we speak purple and work both sides of the aisle in this industry on purpose.

What We Offer

$175,000–$200,000 plus benefits. Modern tools, direct executive access, no bureaucracy, and a growth path as the legal function scales with the company.

Qualifications

- JD and active Minnesota bar membership (or imminent admission).

- 5+ years of legal experience; regulated-industry exposure (cannabis, alcohol, or tobacco) strongly preferred.

- Commercial contracts and/or real estate experience preferred; multi unit retail or franchise agreements experience a plus.

- Meticulous, organized, autonomous, and genuinely enthusiastic about AI in legal practice.

At Minnesota Cannabis Services, we believe great teams are built on trust, initiative, and follow-through. We invest deeply in our people — providing mentorship, on-the-job training, and opportunities for advancement across multiple sectors of the cannabis industry.

Here, you’ll be part of a high-performing culture that values precision, reliability, and continuous improvement. Every project is a chance to grow your skills, strengthen your leadership, and contribute to something that matters.

If you’re driven, resourceful, and ready to make an impact, we want you on our team. Apply today and take the next step in your career with Minnesota Cannabis Services.

title: Early Intervention BCBA – Life Skills Autism Academy (Center-Based)
posting_excerpt:
Are you a BCBA passionate about early intervention and lifelong impact? At Life Skills Autism Academy, a division of Centria Autism, we provide full-time, center-based ABA therapy for children ages 5 and under. Our mission is clear: deliver compassionate, evidence-based care during the most critical developmental window, so every child has the best chance to thrive.

Compensation & Incentives – Earn a base salary of $90,000–$100,000, plus weekly and monthly bonus opportunities (typically averaging $1,000/month).

$10,000 sign on bonus to welcome you to the team! 

What Centria Offers:

- Early Intervention, Big Impact – Help shape a child’s future during the years when ABA therapy can make the most significant developmental difference.

- Purpose-Built Centers – Our LSAA centers are thoughtfully designed for children 5 and under, with low-distraction spaces, play-based learning areas, and a strong emphasis on routines and safety.

- Clinical Quality First – We prioritize outcomes, not billables. Our proprietary CareConnect platform streamlines everything from treatment planning to data collection so you can stay focused on care, not paperwork.

- Assent-Based and Play-Focused – We blend Practical Functional Assessment and Skills-Based Treatment into a compassionate, assent-based model, centered around joyful, meaningful learning.

- Real Work-Life Balance – Small caseloads, manageable schedules, and dedicated support teams mean no last-minute chaos and no burnout.

- You're Never Alone – With layered support from Clinical Directors, Area Clinical Directors, and our Clinical Excellence Team, you'll always have someone in your corner.

- No Operational Headaches – We handle the logistics. From scheduling to onboarding of technicians, our operations team keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

- Career Growth on Your Terms – Whether you're mentoring the next generation of BCBAs, leading clinical training, or stepping into leadership, we support your growth.

- We Invest in You – From CEU stipends and paid CEU days to exclusive internal training events, we’re serious about keeping you sharp—and helping you level up.

- Perks That Actually Matter – Annual, all-inclusive vacation for two, early wage access, a company car or mileage reimbursement, and full benefits.

- No Non-Compete – We don’t believe in holding people back. If we’re not the right long-term fit, you’ll still leave better prepared for your next step.

Your Role & Impact as a BCBA

- Lead ABA therapy delivery within a collaborative, in-center environment

- Provide daily support and guidance to Behavior Technicians to ensure clinical excellence

- Develop and implement assent-based, individualized behavior plans following ABA principles

- Engage parents during scheduled on-site training sessions to drive meaningful progress

- Maintain high-quality clinical services through regular supervision and data-driven decision-making

At Life Skills Autism Academy, you’re not just supporting kids—you’re shaping futures. Join a team that believes in early intervention, compassionate care, and your potential as a leader. Apply today and help build the foundation for a child’s lifelong success.

Centria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: VP, Global Head of Commercial Transactions @ Ping Identity
posting_excerpt:
SECURING DIGITAL FREEDOM FOR EVERY IDENTITY  


LEADING THE FUTURE OF SEAMLESS, TRUSTED DIGITAL EXPERIENCES  

Ping Identity is seeking a VP, Global Head of Commercial Transactions to lead its global commercial legal function. This executive role is responsible for overseeing a team of experienced attorneys and contract professionals, driving the negotiation of complex technology and commercial agreements, and enabling scalable business growth across Ping Identity’s global enterprise customer base.

The VP, Global Head of Commercial Transactions will serve as the lead negotiator for high-value, strategic transactions—including SaaS subscriptions, software licenses, professional services, and strategic alliances—while building deep, trust-based relationships with C-level stakeholders both internally and externally. The role will drive continuous improvement in contract processes, templates, and playbooks, using metrics to accelerate the sales cycle and manage legal risk.

Collaboration is central to this position. The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Security, and the broader Legal team—including Product, Privacy, Regulatory, AI, and Legal Operations—to align legal strategy with business objectives and ensure compliant, customer-focused outcomes. The role also provides commercial legal support for strategic initiatives such as alliances, channel and reseller programs, and new market entries.

This leader will mentor and develop a global, hybrid team, ensuring operational excellence and strong business partnership. In partnership with the regulatory and privacy teams, the VP will advise on global risk allocation, regulatory implications, and contracting strategy to protect Ping Identity’s interests and support long-term growth.

The ideal candidate brings a Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent international qualification, active legal licensure, and over 20 years of experience in complex commercial and technology transactions, ideally within enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity. Deep expertise in cloud/SaaS contracting, data protection, and AI regulatory frameworks is essential, as is a proven ability to lead global teams, influence senior stakeholders, and implement scalable legal tools and processes.

Ping Identity is committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment where every individual is empowered to bring their authentic self to work.  

Company Website: https://www.pingidentity.com
